Operations Chief (supporting, CHALLENGE): Only 3 machines ever received scheduled maintenance (1 Ridgeline): far too few to support the >86% downtime recovery Ridgeline maintenance needs.

Guest Analyst (primary, PROPOSE_SCENARIO): Carded theo fell 3.4% in the 7 days after both property promotions vs the same weekdays 3-4 weeks earlier. Netting this possible displacement (6,726/promo-day) gives $9,511/day excess.

Loyalty Strategist (primary, SUPPORT): Comp cost per theo on promotion days is 0.881% vs 0.805% otherwise; the model already charges 0.863%. Extra comps change a promotion weekend by about $-9, too little to remove its modeled advantage.
Loyalty Strategist (supporting, REQUEST_EVIDENCE): The 7.6% rise in comp cost per day may have been caused by promotional activity, which would make promotions costlier than modeled.
